description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'OrderProductDownloadUrlTag' that generates a download URL for an order product by constructing a file path based on merchant store and order details, then outputs this URL in a JSP page.

classes.name: OrderProductDownloadUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag class for generating download URLs for order products within a web application.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the product download URL based on request, merchant store, and order product details, then writes it to the JSP output.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends processing of the JSP tag, continues page rendering.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Getter for the order ID associated with the download.

methods.name: getProductDownload
methods.description: Getter for the product download details.

methods.name: setProductDownload
methods.description: Setter for the product download details.
